reason: Owner decision on #1110 (18 Nov 2026): one registry for every hostname Catch serves. Form domains become customDomains records with target.kind form on the firebaseHosting provider, so the organiser-page and form paths share policy, generation fencing and the one-domain-per-organiser limit.

phases.description: resolvePublicFormDomain, the form registry transactions and tool/firebase/form_domain_operator.mjs read and write customDomains only.
The organizerFormDomains schema, Firestore contract entry and rules match are removed; the retired path stays denied by default and the rules test asserts it.

Operator runs tool/data/migrate_form_domains_to_custom_domains.mjs read-only per environment (dev, prod) to count organizerFormDomains. An empty collection needs nothing; otherwise --apply copies each document, then --apply --retire-legacy deletes exact copies. The manager callable was retired on 16 Nov 2026 and no client domain was provisioned, so zero documents are expected but must be measured before deploy.

guards: functions/test/rules/organizers.rules.test.cjs keeps both customDomains form records and the retired organizerFormDomains path denied to every client.
legacyFormDomainMigration.test.ts proves the empty-collection no-op, idempotent re-runs, no overwrite of a differing customDomains record and deletion only of exact copies.
